Obsidian Hybrid Search is a search tool for Obsidian notes. It combines semantic, full-text, title, tag, and link-based search over a note vault. It is offered as an Obsidian plugin, a CLI, and an MCP server so AI agents can search and read notes. It is for Obsidian users who want to find and reuse their own notes, including when they work with AI. It runs locally by default with SQLite, and can optionally use an OpenAI-compatible embedding API. The document does not state a current goal.
